references.title: Using rate-based rule statements in AWS WAF
references.quote: A rate-based rule counts incoming requests and rate limits requests when they are coming at too fast a rate.
references.supports: Rate-based rule chỉ hạn chế nguồn gửi quá nhanh, không chặn người dùng bình thường.

references.title: Protecting the application layer with AWS WAF rate-based rules and Shield Advanced
references.quote: AWS WAF blocks requests from any IP address that exceeds the rule's threshold until the request rate drops down to an acceptable level.
references.supports: Mặc định rate-based rule chặn theo từng IP vượt ngưỡng, phù hợp với tấn công từ hàng trăm IP.

references.title: Geographic match rule statement

references.quote: Use geographic or geo match statements to manage web requests based on country and region of origin.
references.supports: Geo match áp dụng cho toàn bộ request theo quốc gia, không phân biệt người dùng hợp lệ.
